meta.name: slideshow
meta.description: Author a HyperFrames slideshow — a presentation, pitch deck, or interactive deck with discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation, and built-in presenter mode with speaker notes; also converts an existing page into a deck. Output is a navigable deck, not a rendered MP4. If the user didn't explicitly ask for a slideshow, confirm before authoring. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把内容做成分页演示文稿,支持分支跳转、热点导航和演讲者备注,能直接翻页讲解。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要把想法变成一份可现场翻页讲解、带备注的演示文稿。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to turn ideas into a deck you can present page by page with notes.

howto.what: Claude 会为你的演示、路演稿或交互式 deck 编写 HyperFrames 幻灯片：由离散页面组成，支持片段揭示、分支、热点导航和演讲者模式备注；也能把现有网页转成 deck。产出是可导航的 deck，不是渲染好的 MP4。
howto.when: 当你明确要做幻灯片，或从 /hyperframes 路由过来时直接开始；若你只说“presentation”、“pitch deck”、“把这个页面转成 deck” 等，它会先确认再动手。

say.text: 把这几个页面做成一份幻灯片，每页一句完整结论
say.note: 动手前会先搜目录里的现成视觉块

say.text: 给第 2 页加演讲者备注：先讲痛点，别讲公司
say.note: 备注只给演讲者看，观众看不到

say.text: 把这个网页转成可导航的幻灯片，保留原设计
say.note: 它会先问一句确认再开始

howto.what_en: Claude authors a HyperFrames deck: discrete slides with fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation and presenter notes; also converts an existing page into a deck. Output is a navigable deck you present, not a rendered MP4.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you explicitly ask for a slideshow or arrive via /hyperframes; if you only say "presentation", "pitch deck" or "convert this page", it confirms before authoring.

say_en.text: Turn these pages into a deck, one complete-sentence claim per slide
say_en.note: It searches the catalog before authoring slides.

say_en.text: Add presenter notes to slide 2: lead with the pain
say_en.note: Notes are presenter-only, hidden from the audience.

say_en.text: Convert this web page into a navigable deck, keeping its design
say_en.note: It confirms intent before it starts.
